accept(uint256,uint256).notice: The calling agent accepts a posted job inside a live mandate that allows its kind and has cap left.

approve(uint256).notice: A reviewer (never the agent, a higher rank) approves a delivered job: the escrow pays the agent.

checkAgent(address).notice: Read-only: the identity of an agent.

checkMandate(uint256).notice: Read-only: a mandate and whether it can accept a new job right now.

deactivateAgent(address).notice: Deactivate an agent (a higher rank only). Running jobs can still be refunded.

deliver(uint256,bytes32).notice: The agent of an accepted job delivers its result hash.

followUp(uint256,uint128).notice: A reviewer pays a follow-up reward on an approved job, once, within the mandate cap.

grantMandate((address,bytes32[],uint128,.notice: Grant a mandate from signed terms (EIP-712). Reverts on a replayed nonce, a past expiry, a zero cap,         an empty or oversized allowlist, an inactive agent, or a bad signature.

isKindAllowed(uint256,bytes32).notice: Read-only: whether a mandate allows a job kind.

post(bytes32,bytes32,uint128,address,uin.notice: Post a job and escrow `reward` of `currency`.

refundExpired(uint256).notice: Refund the poster of a job that was not delivered by its deadline.

registerAgent(address,uint8).notice: Register an agent (admin only; the rank must be below the caller's).

reject(uint256).notice: A reviewer rejects a delivered job: the escrow is refunded to the poster.

revokeMandate(uint256).notice: Revoke a mandate: the grantor or any higher rank, instant, irreversible.
